entry.title: Open Gemini 4 Argon Robot Harness: a zero-shot bimanual handover case study 🤖

link.title: Open Gemini 4 Argon Robot Harness: a zero-shot bimanual handover case study 🤖

entry.content: An open reimplementation of the observation-and-motion-primitive interface from Google’s Gemini 4 Argon robotics report, extended to two arms and tested on a zero-shot bimanual handover. Read the case study · Code.
entry.summary: An open harness for Gemini-driven robot control, extended to two arms, tested on a zero-shot clamp handover.

entry.title: RoboVista leaderboard update: Gemini 4 Argon leads at 81.3% 🏆

link.title: RoboVista leaderboard update: Gemini 4 Argon leads at 81.3% 🏆

entry.content:
The RoboVista leaderboard has been updated (2026-10-15) and now covers 30 models (23 open-weight, 7 API) on 460 multiple-choice spatial-reasoning questions over real robot scenes, each run with a standard and (for most) a chain-of-thought prompt. The benchmark is available on Hugging Face.

Gemini 4 Argon is the new top model at 81.3%, ahead of GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1, at the lowest evaluation cost of the three. Compared with Gemini 3 Flash, it improves in every robotics domain. (Announcement on X)

Top 8 by standard-prompt accuracy (%). The best open-weight model is qwen3.5-397b-a17b at 55.2%. See the full leaderboard for all 30 models and the per-domain breakdown.

Charts from the announcement on X. They were made before the leaderboard's answer re-parsing, so their scores are a few tenths of a point higher (e.g. 81.9% vs. 81.3% for Gemini 4 Argon).
entry.summary: The October 2026 RoboVista update: 30 VLMs evaluated on real robot tasks, led by Gemini 4 Argon.
